task.title: What to Do in Case of an Emergency
task.shortdesc: Steps to take in the event of a fire, flooding, unusual smell or smoke, or unusual noises from Powerwall 3.

prereq.p: In the event of any threat to health or safety, always complete the following two steps before addressing the scenario-specific steps below:

ol.li: Immediately contact the fire department or other relevant emergency response team.
Notify all people who might be affected and ensure that they can evacuate the area.

note.p: Only perform the suggested actions below if it is safe to do so.

step.cmd: On Powerwall 3 systems with additional interconnected solar, turn off the AC breaker for all solar inverters.
Turn off all Powerwall(s), then turn off the AC breaker to Powerwall(s).
Turn off the Powerwall 3 integrated DC isolator.
Turn off the AC breaker to the Gateway, if installed.
If using a fire extinguisher, use only water, CO2, or ABC type extinguishers.

note.p: Do not use type D (flammable metal) extinguishers.

step.cmd: Stay out of the water if any part of the battery, Gateway, or wiring is submerged.
On Powerwall 3 systems with additional interconnected solar, turn off the AC breaker for all solar inverters.
Turn off all Powerwall(s), then turn off the AC breaker to Powerwall(s).
Turn off the Powerwall 3 integrated DC isolator.
Turn off the AC breaker to the Gateway, if installed.
If possible, find and stop the source of the water and pump water away from the system.
If any part of the unit was submerged, note the depth and duration of the flooding.
Contact Tesla Support to determine if the unit can be safely turned back on.
If Tesla Support confirms it is safe to turn the unit back on, allow the area to dry completely before use.
On Powerwall 3 systems with additional interconnected solar, turn off the AC breaker for all solar inverters.
Turn off all Powerwall(s), then turn off the AC breaker to Powerwall(s).
Turn off the Powerwall 3 integrated DC isolator.
Turn off the AC breaker to the Gateway, if installed.
Ensure nothing is in contact with Powerwall.
Ventilate the room.
Turn off all Powerwall(s), then turn off the AC breaker to Powerwall(s).
Turn off the Powerwall 3 integrated DC isolator.
Turn off the AC breaker to the Gateway, if installed.
Ensure that nothing is blocking the air intake or exhaust vents on the Powerwall or in the fan.

postreq.p: In all cases, once the situation is stable, contact the Tesla Certified Installer who installed the system.
For first responder information, see tesla.com/firstresponders.
